h1: The 6 Best 1L Electric Kettles of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six 1 liter electric kettles in stainless steel and glass, with wattage, spout style and price brackets compared.
summary: The Amazon Basics 1L stainless kettle is the best all-rounder at 1500W. The Cuisinart double-wall model and ZWILLING Enfinigy Cool Touch stay cooler outside, the YPJKR 1.0L adds a gooseneck spout, and the Hamilton Beach 1L and Amazon Basics glass are the cheapest.
intro: A 1 liter kettle boils about four cups, which is plenty for one or two people but too small for a family. The common mistake is buying 1L and then refilling it three times for a pot.
We reviewed 1L kettles on listed material, wattage, wall design and spout. Six made the cut, ranked by balance of speed, safety and price.

products.name: Amazon Basics Electric Stainless Steel Kettle for Tea and Coffee
products.verdict: A 1500W stainless steel 1L kettle that balances speed and price.
products.description:
This Amazon Basics kettle is stainless steel, 1500W and 1 liter, priced $25-50.

It ranks first because stainless steel and 1500W cover the basics well. Against the glass version, it costs more but hides the internals.

It suits one or two drinkers.

products.name: Cuisinart Electric Kettle
products.description:
The Cuisinart has double-wall stainless construction and 1 liter capacity at $25-50.

It ranks second because the double wall helps keep the outside cooler. Against the Amazon Basics, it adds that wall but lists no wattage.

It suits shared kitchens.

products.name: ZWILLING Enfinigy Cool Touch Electric Kettle
products.verdict: A double-wall stainless kettle from a premium brand.
products.description:
The ZWILLING Enfinigy Cool Touch is double-wall stainless at 1 liter, priced $50-100.

It ranks third because the Cuisinart offers the same wall for less. Against it, you pay for the brand.

It suits buyers who want a design piece.

products.name: YPJKR Electric Kettle 1.0L
products.verdict: A 1200W stainless kettle with a gooseneck spout.
products.description:
The YPJKR is stainless steel, 1200W and 1 liter with a gooseneck spout. It costs $25-50.

It ranks fourth because its power is lower than the 1500W models. Against Amazon Basics, it pours more precisely.

It suits pour-over coffee.

products.name: Hamilton Beach 1 Liter Electric Tea Kettle
products.description:
The Hamilton Beach is a 1 liter tea kettle priced under $25 with few other specs listed.

It ranks fifth because the listing lacks material and wattage. Against the Amazon Basics glass, it is a known appliance brand.

It suits basic boiling.

products.name: Amazon Basics Electric Kettle with Glass Carafe for Tea and Coffee
products.description:
This Amazon Basics kettle has a glass carafe, 1500W and 1 liter, priced under $25.

It ranks last because glass shows limescale and gets hot. Against the stainless version, it saves money.

It suits buyers who want to watch the boil.

whatMatters.detail: Higher wattage boils faster. 1500W is common. Check the number in the listing.
Stainless is durable; glass lets you watch. Check the listing.
A double wall keeps the outside cooler. Check for double-wall wording.
Gooseneck pours precisely. Check the spout.
1L boils about four cups. Check household size.
